description: Download and install GlobalProtect from https://vpn.company.com/downloads
Connect using the same server address (vpn.company.com) and credentials
Check your network connection and ensure the firewall is not blocking port 443 (if experiencing connection timeout)
Confirm your password has not expired; reset it at https://password.company.com if necessary (if experiencing authentication failure)
Try disconnecting and reconnecting, or contact IT hotline ext.8888 (if unable to access intranet after connecting)
Switch to 5GHz WiFi or use a wired connection (if experiencing frequent disconnections)
